item.title: Earnest Evans Collection launches January 16 in the west
item.description: Earnest Evans Collection will launch for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Switch, and PC via Steam on January 16 in the west for $19.99, publisher Limited Run Games announced. Physical edition pre-orders will open via Limited Run Games on January 23.

item.title: PS Plus Game Catalog for January: RE Village, Like a Dragon: IW, Expeditions: A MudRunner and more
item.description: Ridge Racer joins PlayStation Plus Premium.

item.title: Review | The Legend of Heroes: Trails Beyond the Horizon (PC) - 8Bit/Digi
item.description: The Legend of Heroes: Trails Beyond the Horizon builds upon the story of its predecessor while also bringing together some of the series' beloved heroes.

item.title: Prince of Persia Sands of Time Remake Rated by ESRB
item.description: The Sands of Time Remake has been rated by the ESRB, confirming platforms, content details, and strengthening expectations for a release date announcement soon.

item.title: The turn-based gem-matching roguelite, ANTHEM#9, is coming to Steam on February 5th
item.description: "Koeda and Shueisha Games are today very happy to announce that their turn-based gem-matching roguelite, ANTHEM#9, is coming to Steam on February 5th." - Koeda and Shueisha Games.

item.title: The retro arcade adventure, Pie in the Sky, is coming to Steam on February 2nd
item.description: "Monster Shop Games and indie.io are today very happy to announce that their retro arcade adventure, Pie in the Sky, is coming to Steam on February 2nd." - Monster Shop Games and indie.io.

item.title: The multiplayer party game, Elemental Brawl, is now available via Steam
item.description: "Mayor Games and indie.io are today very happy to announce that their multiplayer party game, Elemental Brawl, is now available via Steam." - Mayor Games and indie.io.

item.title: Larry Hyrb (Major Nelson) announces he has been laid off by Unity
item.description: Larry writes: "As many of you have been with me during my career in gaming, I'd like to share personal news. Like many in the gaming space recently, I've been laid off from @Unity"

item.title: Ecco the Dolphin Returns With Multiple New Games in Development
item.description: Ecco the Dolphin is returning, with original creators confirming multiple new games and related projects now in development.

item.title: Battlefield 6 Season 2 Starts Feb. 17; First Season Extended
item.description: Battlefield 6 Season 2 will start on February 17, as Season 1 has been extended with the Frostline Bonus Path.
